tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "import opentrons
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Colony PCR prep", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # labware
    tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 2)
    colony_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    pcr_mix_tube = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 4)
    
    # liquids
    pcr_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="pcr mix", description="PCR master mix", display_color="#FF0000")
    pcr_mix_tube["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pcr_mix, volume=500)
    
    colony_liquids = []
    for i in range(1, 17):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"colony {i}", description=f"Colony {i} suspension", display_color=None)
        colony_liquids.append(liq)
        if i <= 12:
            well = f"A{i}"
        else:
            well = f"B{i-12}"
        colony_plate[well].load_liquid(liquid=liq, volume=100)
    
    # pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tiprack])
    
    # distribute PCR mix (20 ul each) using same tip
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    for i in range(1, 17):
        if i <= 12:
            dest = f"A{i}"
        else:
            dest = f"B{i-12}"
        p20.aspirate(20, pcr_mix_tube["A1"])
        p20.dispense(20, pcr_plate[dest])
    p20.drop_tip()
    
    # add 1 ul colony to each well, new tip each, mix after addition
    for i in range(1, 17):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        if i <= 12:
            src = colony_plate[f"A{i}"]
            dest = pcr_plate[f"A{i}"]
        else:
            src = colony_plate[f"B{i-12}"]
            dest = pcr_plate[f"B{i-12}"]
        p20.aspirate(1, src)
        p20.dispense(1, dest)
        p20.mix(5, 16, dest)  # mix 5 times 16ul
        p20.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 note).

1. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No no-template control: 16 wells of pcr mix with a sample
   line 38:  p20.dispense(20, pcr_plate[dest])
   At line 38 the robot starts putting pcr mix into NEST 96 Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full Skirt
   (slot 2), and 16 wells end holding it together with a sample. No well on this plate holds
   the mix without a sample, so there is no no-template control. If a reagent is
   contaminated, or the primers pair with each other, every well gives a signal and nothing
   on the plate can tell that from a real one. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8
   and 8 more in slot 2.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 8 more in slot 2.
   Fix: Add one well (three for qPCR) with 20 ul of pcr mix and 1 ul of water in place of
   the template, and tell the plate map where it is.
